text:
60세 남성 환자, acute congestive heart failure로 입원함.  
BP 200/110 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 24 breaths/min, BT 37.4°C, SpO2 88% room air에서 측정됨.  
Severe dyspnea 호소함.  
Furosemide 40 mg IV STAT 투여함.  
2L nasal cannula 적용함.  
Foley 유지함.  
Negative fluid balance 500 mL 확인됨.  
환자 drowsy 상태 확인됨.  
Cardiology team notify함.
